tracesTo: UserFlow: Weekly Member Engagement, Feed Interaction, Pick'ems & History Browsing

stories.title: View Current Week Regular Season Matchups
stories.goal: see all matchups for the current week when I visit the matchups page
stories.benefit: I can quickly check this week's games and who is playing whom without navigating
acceptanceCriteria: Page defaults to current NFL week on initial load
System displays all regular season matchups for the week in a grid or list layout
Each matchup block shows both team names, logos, and current scores if games are in progress or completed
System automatically updates to new week when NFL schedule advances
Current week is visually indicated in the week selector

stories.title: Select Season for Matchup Viewing
stories.goal: choose which season's matchups I want to view
stories.benefit: I can review historical matchups from previous seasons and compare past results
acceptanceCriteria: Season selector dropdown displays all available seasons with matchup data
Current season is selected by default
Selecting a different season updates the week selector to show valid weeks for that season
Selecting a season loads the most recent completed or current week for that season
Dynasty leagues show continuous season history, redraft leagues show independent seasons
Season selector clearly indicates current season with label or visual marker

stories.title: Navigate Between Weeks with Continuous Horizontal Selector
stories.goal: easily browse through different weeks of matchups within a season
stories.benefit: I can review past weeks and preview future matchups with intuitive navigation
acceptanceCriteria: Week selector is displayed as continuous horizontal scrollable/swipeable strip
Each week is represented as a clickable element in the strip (e.g., Week 1, Week 2, etc.)
Current selected week is visually highlighted in the selector
User can click/tap a week to load that week's matchups
Week selector supports horizontal scrolling for seasons with many weeks
System distinguishes between regular season weeks and playoff weeks visually
Week selector adapts to mobile with swipe gesture support

stories.title: Display Regular Season Matchup Blocks
stories.goal: see detailed information for each matchup in a clear block format
stories.benefit: I can easily understand matchup details including teams, scores, and status at a glance
acceptanceCriteria: Each matchup is displayed in a dedicated block/card with clear visual separation
Matchup block shows both teams with logos, team names, and manager names
Matchup block displays current scores or final scores prominently
Pre-game matchups show projected scores or empty score placeholders
In-progress matchups indicate live status with visual indicator (e.g., 'LIVE' badge)
Completed matchups clearly show winner with visual emphasis (e.g., bold, highlight)
Matchup blocks are responsive and adapt to mobile screen sizes

stories.title: Identify Featured Matchup of the Week
stories.goal: quickly spot the commissioner's featured matchup on the page
stories.benefit: I can see which game the commissioner considers most important or interesting this week
acceptanceCriteria: Featured matchup is visually distinguished from other matchups (e.g., larger size, special border, highlight color)
Featured matchup displays commissioner's hype text or description if provided
Only one matchup is featured per week as designated by commissioner
If no matchup is featured for a week, all matchups display in standard format
Featured matchup is positioned prominently on the page (e.g., top or center)
Featured indicator is clear and consistent across desktop and mobile views

stories.title: View Live Score Updates for In-Progress Matchups
stories.goal: see real-time or near-real-time score updates for ongoing matchups
stories.benefit: I can follow games as they happen without manually refreshing or leaving the page
acceptanceCriteria: System fetches updated scores from external fantasy platform API at regular intervals
In-progress matchups display current scores that update automatically on the page
User can manually refresh matchup data with a refresh button or pull-to-refresh gesture
System indicates last update timestamp for score data
Score updates happen without full page reload using background data fetching
System handles API rate limits gracefully without breaking page functionality

stories.title: View Final Scores for Completed Matchups
stories.goal: see final scores and winners for matchups that have concluded
stories.benefit: I know the results of past games and can track standings progression
acceptanceCriteria: Completed matchups display final scores with decimal precision as provided by platform
Winner is clearly indicated with visual styling (e.g., bold text, highlight, checkmark)
Loser is visually de-emphasized or shown with neutral styling
Ties are indicated if league rules support tie outcomes
System marks matchups as final after stat corrections are applied by fantasy platform
Final scores persist and do not change unless platform applies late stat corrections

stories.title: Display Matchup Contextual Information
stories.goal: see additional context about each matchup beyond just team names and scores
stories.benefit: I get richer information to understand matchup significance and storylines
acceptanceCriteria: System displays team records (wins-losses) alongside team names in matchup block
System shows playoff implications if applicable (e.g., 'Must-win for playoffs')
Matchup block includes link to more detailed matchup view if available
System displays projected winner based on pre-game projections if available
Historical head-to-head record is optionally displayed for recurring matchups
Contextual information is concise and does not clutter the matchup block

stories.title: Handle Bye Weeks and Uneven Matchups
stories.goal: understand when teams have byes or when matchups are not symmetrical
stories.benefit: I know which teams are not playing this week and see accurate schedule representation
acceptanceCriteria: Teams with byes are clearly indicated on matchups page (e.g., 'BYE' label, grayed out)
Bye teams are displayed separately from active matchups or in a dedicated section
In leagues with uneven team counts, byes rotate according to league schedule
System does not create phantom matchups for teams on bye
Bye week schedule is sourced from fantasy platform league data
Users can quickly identify which teams are active vs on bye for the week

stories.title: Navigate to Playoff Bracket from Matchups Page
stories.goal: easily switch to viewing playoff bracket when postseason begins
stories.benefit: I can seamlessly transition from regular season matchups to playoff structure visualization
acceptanceCriteria: System automatically detects when league enters playoff weeks based on league settings
Page displays prominent link or tab to switch to playoff bracket view during postseason
Regular season matchup view remains accessible even during playoffs for historical reference
System provides clear indication of when playoffs begin (e.g., 'Playoffs start Week 15')
Navigation between matchups page and bracket page maintains season and week context
System handles both standard and custom playoff start weeks based on league configuration

stories.title: View Week Selector on Mobile Devices
stories.goal: navigate between weeks on my mobile device with touch-optimized controls
stories.benefit: I have a smooth experience browsing matchups on smaller screens
acceptanceCriteria: Continuous week selector adapts to mobile viewport with horizontal swipe support
Week elements in selector have adequate touch target size for easy tapping
Swiping left/right scrolls through weeks smoothly without page navigation conflicts
Selected week is centered in viewport when possible for better visibility
System provides visual feedback for week selection (e.g., animation, highlight)
Week selector does not interfere with vertical scrolling of matchup list

stories.title: Filter and Sort Matchups
stories.goal: organize matchup display based on my preferences or specific criteria
stories.benefit: I can prioritize viewing matchups that are most relevant or interesting to me
acceptanceCriteria: System provides sort options (e.g., by score differential, by team name, by playoff seeding)
User can filter matchups by status (e.g., show only live games, show only completed)
Sort and filter preferences are applied immediately without page reload
System persists user's sort/filter preferences for their session or future visits
Default sort order is by matchup scheduling or seeding as determined by league
Filter and sort controls are accessible but not intrusive to main matchup view
